name: filter-rsql
title: Filter RSQL
description: Writes a filter-schema AST as RSQL/FIQL for rsql-jpa-specification and other RSQL backends: `;` and, `,` or, parentheses, quoted and escaped arguments.
docs: `rsql(toFilterAst(schema, values), { isNull })` returns the `filter` param: `status=in=("open","closed");amount=ge=100`. `not` is pushed down to the comparisons, a negated text match becomes `!=` with wildcards, and `isNull` picks `=isnull=` (default, as rsql-jpa-specification reads it) or `=null=`. Like every serializer it takes `fields` (a whitelist, `schemaFields(schema)`) and `dates`, and throws a `FilterSerializeError` for what it can't write safely. Pass it to a source as `params: (filter) => ({ filter: rsql(toFilterAst(schema, filter)) })`.
